WELCOME TO YOUR WORKBENCH

A little room
goes a long way.

Move the brass kit to the opening on the right. Slide the other parts out of its path.

  1. Drag a part along its track.
  2. Or tap a part, then use the arrow buttons.
  3. Parts cannot rotate or pass through each other.

Keyboard: Tab to a part, Enter to select it, then use arrow keys. Hints show one helpful move. Each square moved uses one move, including dragging multiple squares. A failed repair costs 1 bolt. You start with 3 undos total for the entire game. An undo restores the last move and its move allowance. Undos do not reset between levels. Additional undos require purchase; Each level can be reset once, costing 1 bolt. The reset does not refill undos. There is no time limit.
